items.prompt:
A COMPLEX character is one who:
A) has multiple or conflicting motivations
B) is simply all good
C) never appears
items.answer: A) has multiple or conflicting motivations

solution.answer: A) has multiple or conflicting motivations

items.prompt:
A character who changes over the course of a text:
A) develops (is dynamic)
B) is static
C) is a setting

A character's choices can:
A) advance the plot
B) change the font
C) do nothing

Read.

Torn between loyalty to his friend and his duty to the law, the officer hesitated, then made the arrest.

This shows the officer is:
A) complex, with conflicting motivations
B) a flat, simple character
C) unimportant

How can a complex character develop the THEME?
A) their inner conflict can dramatize the central idea
B) they cannot affect theme
C) only the narrator sets theme
items.answer: A) their inner conflict can dramatize the central idea

steps: Conflict embodies theme. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) their inner conflict can dramatize the central idea

items.prompt:
A sympathetic villain (one with understandable motives) is an example of:
A) a complex character
B) a flat character
C) the setting

steps: Not pure evil. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Read.

The queen loved her son yet feared his weakness would doom the realm; her divided heart led her to both shield and test him cruelly.

This BEST illustrates how:
A) a character's conflicting motivations drive her contradictory actions and the plot
B) characters never have mixed feelings
C) setting controls everything
items.answer: A) a character's conflicting motivations drive her contradictory actions and the plot

steps: Mixed motives drive action. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) a character's conflicting motivations drive her contradictory actions and the plot

items.prompt:
A FOIL character functions mainly to:
A) highlight a main character's traits by contrast
B) narrate the story
C) provide the setting
items.answer: A) highlight a main character's traits by contrast

steps: Contrast reveals the protagonist. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) highlight a main character's traits by contrast
